generic.Defined scope/population: The quote version the broker is binding against and every condition attached to that quote letter
generic.In-scope period: From quote issue date through the requested bind effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote expiry date, quote status and quote version number present on the quote record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of conditions on the quote letter equals the count marked Met or Outstanding
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validity file note saved against the quote with version number and check date and time
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed or superseded quotes logged with the re-date or re-quote decision and reason
generic.Test population: All bind transactions executed in the period from quotes held in the underwriting workstation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero binds executed against expired, withdrawn or superseded quote versions
generic.Exception handling path: Expired quote referred to the Underwriter for re-date or re-quote before the bind proceeds
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status Quoted, expiry on or after bind date and version matching the broker bind order
generic.Evidence location: Quote record and file note in the underwriting workstation and policy administration system

steps.title: Open the quote record in the underwriting workstation
sop: Search the submission number in the underwriting workstation and open the current quote record.
Read the quote expiry date, quote status and version number from the quote header.
Done when the quote header fields are on screen for the version being bound.
verify: Confirm the opened quote belongs to the submission named on the broker bind order.
Pass when the quote record matches the submission and version on the bind request.

steps.title: Compare the quote expiry date against today in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read the Quote Expiry date field and compare it to the current date and requested effective date.
Flag the quote as lapsed where the expiry date falls before the requested bind date.
Done when the expiry comparison result is recorded on the quote.
verify: Re-read the expiry date and confirm the recorded comparison result matches it.
Pass when the quote expiry date is on or after the requested bind date.

steps.title: Confirm quote status is Quoted or Open in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read the status field on the quote record in the underwriting workstation.
Stop the bind where the status reads Expired, Withdrawn or Superseded.
Done when a status of Quoted or Open is confirmed on the record.
verify: Check no later quote revision exists that would supersede the open status.
Pass when the quote status is Quoted or Open with no later superseding revision.

steps.title: Match the quote version number to the broker bind order
sop: Read the version number on the broker bind order or portal instruction.
Compare it to the version number of the quote open in the underwriting workstation.
Done when both version numbers are confirmed identical.
verify: List all quote versions on the submission and confirm none is later than the one being bound.
Pass when the bound version is the latest issued version referenced by the broker.

steps.title: Mark each quote condition Met or Outstanding on the quote condition list
sop: List every condition printed on the quote letter in the underwriting workstation condition list.
Set each condition to Met or Outstanding based on the evidence held on the submission.
Done when every listed condition carries a Met or Outstanding disposition.
verify: Count conditions on the quote letter and compare to the count dispositioned in the system.
Pass when the counts agree and no condition is left undispositioned.

steps.title: Re-date or re-quote a lapsed quote and file the reason note in the workstation
sop: Where the quote has lapsed, extend the validity date or raise a fresh quote version.
Write the file note recording the extension reason and the approving underwriter.
Done when the re-dated or new quote version is active and the note is filed.
verify: Open the file note and confirm it names the extension reason and the approver.
Pass when every lapsed quote carries a documented extension or re-quote reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: The signed application and the broker bind order for this submission number
generic.In-scope period: From application signature date through the requested policy effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Applicant signature, signature date and submission index number on the stored application
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Two documents expected on file equals two documents indexed to the submission
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Application PDF and e-signature certificate stored in OpenText with upload timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or unsigned applications logged with the chase action and the response date
generic.Test population: All bound submissions in the period held in the document repository
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero binds recorded where the signed application is missing or unsigned
generic.Exception handling path: Unsigned or undated application returned to the broker and the bind checklist item held open
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Both documents indexed to the submission with a signature date on or before effective date
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt submission folder and the bind checklist in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Locate the signed application PDF in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Search OpenText Document Mgmt by submission number and open the application document.
Confirm the document type code is Signed Application rather than draft or proposal.
Done when the signed application PDF opens under the correct submission index.
verify: Check the index metadata carries the submission number used by the underwriting workstation.
Pass when the signed application is retrievable by submission number in the repository.

steps.title: Check the applicant signature and signature date on the application
sop: Read the signature block and confirm a signature is present for the named applicant.
Compare the signature date to the requested effective date on the bind order.
Done when the signature is present and dated on or before the effective date.
verify: Re-read the signature date and confirm it precedes or equals the requested effective date.
Pass when no application is accepted with a signature dated after the effective date.

steps.title: Verify the DocuSign certificate of completion is attached
sop: For e-signed applications, open the DocuSign envelope and download the certificate audit page.
Confirm the signer name, email and completion timestamp on the certificate.
Done when the certificate is attached to the application in the repository.
verify: Match the certificate envelope id to the envelope referenced on the application.
Pass when every e-signed application carries its matching DocuSign certificate.

steps.title: Confirm the broker bind order names the required binding terms
sop: Open the broker bind order email or portal instruction stored on the submission.
Confirm it names the insured, effective date, limits and premium being bound.
Done when all four terms are present on the bind order.
verify: Compare the named terms against the quote being bound in the underwriting workstation.
Pass when the bind order terms match the quote with no unexplained variance.

steps.title: Index both documents to the submission in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Upload or re-index the signed application and bind order under the submission number.
Apply the correct document type code to each so retention rules apply.
Done when both documents appear under the submission in the repository.
verify: Run a submission document listing and count the indexed bind documents.
Pass when both the application and the bind order are listed under the submission.

steps.title: Tick the Signed Application and Bind Order items on the workstation bind checklist
sop: Open the bind checklist on the submission in the underwriting workstation.
Mark the Signed Application and Bind Order items complete with the check date.
Done when both checklist items show complete with the checker name recorded.
verify: Confirm no bind checklist item remains open for the documentation section.
Pass when both items are complete and the checklist releases the bind step.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every co-insurer or syndicate participant on the shared or syndicated placement slip
generic.In-scope period: From placement slip issue through the bind date of the shared-line risk
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written line percentage, participant name and sign-off reference for each participation
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Signed lines across all participants total 100 percent of the placed order
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed slip or sign-off correspondence attached to the submission with received date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short or over-placed lines logged with the correction action and the outcome
generic.Test population: All shared-line or syndicated risks bound in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero shared-line risks bound without lead or co-underwriter sign-off on file
generic.Exception handling path: Unsigned participation escalated to the Senior Underwriter and the bind held until signed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed slip totalling 100 percent with our net line inside the binding underwriter authority
generic.Evidence location: Submission folder in OpenText Document Mgmt and the shared-line flag in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List participants and written lines from the placement slip in the workstation
sop: Open the placement slip attached to the submission in the underwriting workstation.
Record each co-insurer or syndicate participant with its written line percentage.
Done when every participant and its written line is captured on the submission.
verify: Compare the captured list to the slip and confirm no participant is missing.
Pass when the captured participant list matches the placement slip exactly.

steps.title: Total the signed lines and confirm the order is fully placed
sop: Add the signed line percentages recorded for all participants.
Investigate and resolve any short placement or over-placement before binding.
Done when the signed lines total 100 percent of the placed order.
verify: Recalculate the total from the slip figures independently of the captured list.
Pass when both calculations reach 100 percent with no rounding gap.

steps.title: Collect the co-underwriter or lead sign-off for each participation
sop: Request the sign-off email or stamped slip from each co-underwriter or the lead.
Chase any participant that has not returned sign-off before the bind date.
Done when a sign-off exists for every shared participation.
verify: Count sign-offs held against the number of participants on the slip.
Pass when the sign-off count equals the participant count.

steps.title: Check the net signed line against the binding underwriter authority
sop: Calculate our net signed line from the placement slip percentages.
Compare that net line to the scheduled authority of the underwriter binding the risk.
Done when the net line is confirmed inside the binding underwriter authority band.
verify: Re-check the authority band recorded for the binding underwriter in the workstation.
Pass when the net signed line sits within that authority band.

steps.title: Attach the signed slip and sign-off correspondence in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Upload the signed placement slip and each sign-off message under the submission number.
Apply the shared-line document type code so the pack is retrievable at audit.
Done when the slip and all sign-offs are indexed to the submission.
verify: Open each uploaded document and confirm it is legible and complete.
Pass when every sign-off document opens and is indexed to the submission.

steps.title: Set the Shared Line Sign-off flag in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the submission control screen and set the Shared Line Sign-off flag.
Record the sign-off date and the approving senior underwriter against the flag.
Done when the flag is set and the bind step is released.
verify: Confirm the flag cannot be set where a participation sign-off is still outstanding.
Pass when the flag is set only with a complete sign-off set on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: All broker, MGA or insured bind requests received for this submission
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the bind instruction through the requested effective date and time
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Received date and time, requesting party, producer code and quote number on the log entry
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of bind requests received equals the count logged in the underwriting workstation
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Portal message or email retained with the received timestamp against the submission
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Backdated or same-day requests logged with the referral outcome recorded
generic.Test population: All bind requests received through the Broker and Agent Portal or email in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero verbal binders left undocumented beyond 24 hours of instruction
generic.Exception handling path: Backdated request referred to the Underwriter before the request is accepted for bind
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Request logged with received date and time, originating broker and correct quote option
generic.Evidence location: Submission record in the underwriting workstation and the case record in the workflow tool

steps.title: Capture the bind request from the Broker and Agent Portal or email
sop: Open the incoming instruction in the Broker and Agent Portal or the shared mailbox.
Save the message against the submission so the original wording is retained.
Done when the original bind instruction is stored on the submission.
verify: Reopen the stored message and confirm the full instruction text is readable.
Pass when the original instruction is retrievable from the submission record.

steps.title: Log the request with received date and time in the underwriting workstation
sop: Create the bind request log entry on the submission in the underwriting workstation.
Enter the date and time the instruction was received, not the date it is being keyed.
Done when the log entry carries an accurate received date and time.
verify: Compare the logged received time to the portal or email header timestamp.
Pass when the logged time matches the source timestamp.

steps.title: Record the requesting party and producer code on the log entry
sop: Identify whether the request came from the broker, the MGA or the insured directly.
Enter the requesting party and the producer code shown on the instruction.
Done when both fields are populated on the bind request log.
verify: Match the producer code against the producer record held on the submission.
Pass when the logged producer code matches the submission producer.

steps.title: Check the requested effective date and time and flag backdated requests
sop: Read the requested effective date and time of day from the instruction.
Raise a referral flag in the workflow tool for any backdated or same-day request.
Done when the effective date is recorded and any backdating is flagged.
verify: Confirm every backdated request carries an open referral in the workflow tool.
Pass when no backdated request proceeds without a recorded referral.

steps.title: Confirm the request references the correct quote number and option
sop: Read the quote number and option named on the bind instruction.
Confirm the option matches primary or alternative terms as intended by the broker.
Done when the quote number and option are confirmed on the log entry.
verify: Open the referenced quote option and confirm it is still available for bind.
Pass when the referenced quote option exists and is not withdrawn.

steps.title: Document verbal instructions and confirm back in writing within 24 hours
sop: Write the file note capturing the verbal instruction, caller name and time of the call.
Send the written confirmation to the broker through the portal within 24 hours.
Done when the note is filed and the written confirmation is sent.
verify: Compare the confirmation send time to the logged call time.
Pass when every verbal binder is confirmed in writing within 24 hours.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every subjectivity listed on the quote for the risk being bound
generic.In-scope period: From quote issue through bind, plus diary dates for subjectivities carried forward
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, evidence reference, owner and due date populated for each subjectivity
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Subjectivities on the quote equal those dispositioned on the subjectivity register
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Clearing evidence stored in OpenText with the date it was received against each item
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Subjectivities carried past bind logged as condition precedent or warranty with a due date
generic.Test population: All risks bound in the period carrying one or more quote subjectivities
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero subjectivities left Open with no owner after bind
generic.Exception handling path: Uncleared subjectivity converted to a condition precedent and diarised to the named underwriter
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register shows every item Cleared or Carried with an owner and a due date at bind
generic.Evidence location: Subjectivity register in the underwriting workstation and evidence in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Open the subjectivity list on the quote in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the quote and display the subjectivity list attached to it.
Record each subjectivity with its current status on the reconciliation working list.
Done when every subjectivity on the quote appears on the working list.
verify: Count subjectivities on the quote letter against the working list.
Pass when the counts agree with no item omitted.

steps.title: Match each cleared subjectivity to its evidence in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: For each item marked cleared, locate the supporting document in the repository.
Record the document reference against the subjectivity on the register.
Done when every cleared item carries an evidence reference.
verify: Open a sample of referenced documents and confirm they support the clearance.
Pass when no item is marked cleared without retrievable supporting evidence.

steps.title: Convert uncleared subjectivities to condition precedent or warranty wording
sop: Review each item still outstanding and decide whether it can be carried past bind.
Select the condition precedent or warranty wording to carry the item into the policy.
Done when each carried item has policy wording selected in the workstation.
verify: Confirm the selected wording appears on the terms screen for the bound risk.
Pass when every carried subjectivity is represented by policy wording.

steps.title: Set diary dates and named owners for carried subjectivities
sop: Create a diary item in the underwriting workstation for each carried subjectivity.
Assign the responsible underwriter and set the compliance due date.
Done when every carried item has an owner and a diary date.
verify: List carried items and check each shows an owner and a future due date.
Pass when no carried subjectivity lacks an owner or a due date.

steps.title: Mark the subjectivity register Complete in the underwriting workstation
sop: Confirm every item reads Cleared or Carried with no item left Open.
Set the subjectivity register status to Complete on the submission.
Done when the register status reads Complete.
verify: Attempt to bind and confirm the system blocks where an item is still Open.
Pass when the register cannot read Complete with an Open item outstanding.

steps.title: Record the reconciliation in the submission file note before authorising bind
sop: Write the file note summarising cleared items, carried items and their due dates.
Name the underwriter who performed the reconciliation and the date completed.
Done when the note is saved against the submission ahead of bind.
verify: Read the note and confirm it accounts for every subjectivity on the register.
Pass when the note reconciles item for item to the register.

generic.Defined scope/population: Named insured, additional insureds, parent entities and risk location countries on this risk
generic.In-scope period: The 24 hours immediately preceding the bind authorisation
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Screened entity names, screening reference number and adjudication reason on each result
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entities on the submission equal the entities screened on the final clearance run
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening result attached with its run timestamp and reference number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Potential matches logged as true hit or false positive with the reason recorded
generic.Test population: All risks bound in the period requiring a pre-bind sanctions clearance
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies bound with an unadjudicated potential sanctions match outstanding
generic.Exception handling path: True hit escalated to Compliance and the bind held until written clearance is received
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clear screening result dated within 24 hours of bind attached to the submission
generic.Evidence location: Sanctions screening system case record and the submission in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Assemble the screening entity list from the underwriting workstation
sop: List the named insured, additional insureds and any parent entity from the submission.
Add the risk location country and any declared overseas operations to the list.
Done when the full entity and territory list is ready for screening.
verify: Compare the list to the parties recorded on the quote and application.
Pass when no party on the submission is missing from the screening list.

steps.title: Run the final screen in the sanctions screening system within 24 hours of bind
sop: Submit the entity list to the sanctions screening system as a pre-bind clearance run.
Record the run date, time and screening reference number returned.
Done when the screening run completes and returns a reference number.
verify: Compare the run timestamp to the planned bind time.
Pass when the run timestamp is within 24 hours of the bind.

steps.title: Screen territories against comprehensive-sanctions jurisdictions
sop: Screen the risk location country and overseas operations against the jurisdiction lists.
Flag any exposure to a comprehensively sanctioned jurisdiction for referral.
Done when every territory on the risk carries a screening outcome.
verify: Check each declared territory appears in the screening output.
Pass when no declared territory is left unscreened.

steps.title: Adjudicate each potential match and record the reason
sop: Review each potential match returned against the underlying entity data.
Mark it a true hit or a false positive and type the reason for the disposition.
Done when no potential match is left unadjudicated.
verify: Read a sample of dispositions and confirm each carries a written reason.
Pass when every potential match has a disposition and a reason.

steps.title: Escalate any true hit to Compliance and hold the bind
sop: Refer any true hit to Compliance with the screening reference and entity detail.
Place a hold on the bind in the underwriting workstation until clearance is received.
Done when the referral is raised and the bind hold is applied.
verify: Confirm the bind hold blocks the bind action while the referral is open.
Pass when no bind proceeds while a true hit referral is unresolved.

steps.title: Attach the clear screening result to the submission before bind authorisation
sop: Export the cleared screening result with its reference number and run timestamp.
Attach it to the submission in the underwriting workstation.
Done when the clear result is attached and the bind step is released.
verify: Open the attached result and confirm the reference number and timestamp are legible.
Pass when the attached clear result is dated within 24 hours of the bind.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every ordered survey, loss-control recommendation and protection warranty on the risk
generic.In-scope period: From survey order date through the bind date, plus warranty compliance dates set
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Survey report reference, recommendation status and selected warranty wording per location
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled locations equal the locations with a survey report or a documented waiver
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Survey reports filed in OpenText with report date and surveyor reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open recommendations logged as completed, waived or written as a warranty with a date
generic.Test population: All bound risks in the period where a survey or loss-control inspection was ordered
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unresolved critical recommendations left without a warranty or a waiver at bind
generic.Exception handling path: Outstanding recommendation converted to a condition precedent with a compliance date before bind
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Survey report and warranty confirmation on file for every scheduled location
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt survey folder and the warranty screen in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: List ordered surveys against scheduled locations in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the location schedule and list every location requiring a survey.
Record the survey order reference and status for each of those locations.
Done when every scheduled location shows a survey order status.
verify: Count scheduled locations against locations with a survey order recorded.
Pass when every location requiring a survey has an order recorded.

steps.title: Confirm each survey report is filed in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Locate the completed survey report for each ordered location in the repository.
Record the report reference and report date against the location.
Done when a report is on file for every ordered survey.
verify: Open a sample of reports and confirm the location addresses match the schedule.
Pass when every ordered survey has a retrievable matching report.

steps.title: Disposition each recommendation as completed, waived or written as a warranty
sop: List the recommendations raised in each survey report.
Mark each one completed, waived by the underwriter, or carried as a policy warranty.
Done when every recommendation carries one of the three dispositions.
verify: Check that each waiver names the waiving underwriter and the reason.
Pass when no recommendation is left without a disposition or a named waiver.

steps.title: Reconcile protection warranties to what the survey recorded
sop: Compare sprinkler, alarm and hot-work warranties against the survey findings.
Amend or remove a warranty the survey does not support before bind.
Done when every protection warranty is supported by the survey record.
verify: Re-read the survey protection section against the warranty list.
Pass when no warranty contradicts the surveyed protection at the location.

steps.title: Match warranty wording in the workstation to the wording on the quote
sop: Open the warranty selection screen and read the wording codes applied.
Compare each code to the warranty referenced on the quote letter.
Done when the system wording matches the quoted wording.
verify: Print the terms screen and compare warranty codes line by line to the quote.
Pass when there is no variance between system and quoted warranty wording.

steps.title: Record outstanding recommendations as condition precedent with compliance dates
sop: Enter each outstanding recommendation as a condition precedent on the risk.
Set the compliance date and the underwriter responsible for follow-up.
Done when every outstanding item is a dated condition precedent.
verify: List conditions precedent and confirm each has a compliance date in the future.
Pass when no outstanding recommendation is carried without a compliance date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The producing agency and the individual producer on the business being bound
generic.In-scope period: Licence and appointment status as at the bind date of the risk
generic.Required fields populated and valid: National producer number, licence status, licensed lines and appointment status recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Producers on the bind order equal the producers verified in NIPR for the risk state
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: NIPR lookup result stored with lookup date against the producer record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed or terminated licences and appointments logged with the bind hold outcome
generic.Test population: All policies bound in the period through appointed producers
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies bound through a producer whose appointment is terminated or lapsed
generic.Exception handling path: Unlicensed or unappointed producer referred to UW Operations and the bind held
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Active licence covering the risk state and line, plus an in-force carrier appointment
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the underwriting workstation and the Broker and Agent Portal profile

steps.title: Look up the producer in NIPR by national producer number
sop: Read the national producer number from the Broker and Agent Portal profile.
Search NIPR by that number and open the producer licensing record.
Done when the NIPR record for the producer is on screen.
verify: Confirm the NIPR record name matches the producer named on the bind order.
Pass when the NIPR record and the bind order name the same producer.

steps.title: Confirm the NIPR licence status reads Active
sop: Read the licence status and expiry date on the NIPR record.
Stop the verification where the status is anything other than Active.
Done when an Active licence status is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the status and expiry date directly from NIPR rather than a cached note.
Pass when the licence is Active and unexpired at the bind date.

steps.title: Check the licence covers the risk state and line of business
sop: Read the licensed states and lines of authority on the NIPR record.
Compare them to the risk state and the line of business being bound.
Done when the risk state and line both appear on the licence.
verify: Confirm the line of authority names the exact product line being bound.
Pass when both the risk state and the bound line are covered.

steps.title: Verify the carrier appointment is in force in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the producer appointment record for our underwriting company entity.
Confirm the appointment is in force and not terminated or lapsed for the risk state.
Done when an in-force appointment is confirmed for the entity and state.
verify: Check the appointment termination field is empty for the risk state.
Pass when no termination or lapse date is recorded for the bind state.

steps.title: Confirm agency and individual dual licensing where the state requires it
sop: Check whether the risk state requires both agency and individual licensing.
Verify both the agency and the individual producer hold active licences where required.
Done when the dual licensing requirement is satisfied or confirmed not applicable.
verify: Re-check the state rule reference used for the dual licensing decision.
Pass when dual licensing is evidenced in every state that requires it.

steps.title: Record the verification date and NPN on the producer record
sop: Enter the NIPR verification date and the national producer number on the producer record.
Attach the NIPR lookup result to the record for audit retrieval.
Done when the verification date and NPN are saved and the bind is released.
verify: Confirm the stored verification date is on or before the bind date.
Pass when the producer record shows a current verification and attached evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: Payment method, instalment schedule and premium payment warranty terms for this risk
generic.In-scope period: From bind date through the final instalment due date on the policy term
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Billing method, deposit amount, due dates and premium warranty date on the billing account
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deposit plus instalments on the billing account equal the bound premium
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Premium finance agreement and payment terms approval stored with signature dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Extended payment terms logged with the UW Operations approval reference
generic.Test population: All risks bound in the period carrying a premium payment warranty
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero extended payment terms applied without documented approval
generic.Exception handling path: Terms beyond the standard warranty period escalated to the Billing Operations Manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Billing account holds the agreed method, instalment schedule and premium warranty date
generic.Evidence location: Billing account in the billing and commission platform and the quote in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Read the payment method and warranty period from the quote
sop: Open the quote in the underwriting workstation and read the payment terms section.
Record whether the risk is agency bill or direct bill and the warranty period offered.
Done when the payment method and warranty period are recorded on the submission.
verify: Compare the recorded terms to the terms stated on the quote letter.
Pass when the recorded payment terms match the quote letter.

steps.title: Check the deposit and instalment schedule on the billing account
sop: Open the billing account in the billing and commission platform.
Confirm the deposit or first instalment amount and each due date are recorded.
Done when the full instalment schedule is visible on the account.
verify: Add the deposit and instalments and compare the total to the bound premium.
Pass when the schedule totals the bound premium exactly.

steps.title: Verify the premium finance agreement details where finance is used
sop: Open the premium finance agreement held on the submission.
Confirm it names the correct insured and the correct policy period.
Done when the finance agreement is confirmed to match the risk being bound.
verify: Compare insured name and policy dates on the agreement to the bound terms.
Pass when the finance agreement matches insured and policy period.

steps.title: Confirm the premium payment warranty wording is attached to the risk
sop: Check whether the class or risk profile requires a premium payment warranty.
Confirm the warranty wording is attached on the terms screen where required.
Done when the required warranty wording is attached to the risk.
verify: Read the attached wording and confirm the warranty date is consistent with billing.
Pass when the warranty wording and the billing due dates agree.

steps.title: Escalate extended payment terms to the Billing Operations Manager
sop: Identify any terms extending beyond the standard warranty period.
Raise the approval request to the Billing Operations Manager with the rationale.
Done when the extension request is raised and awaiting decision.
verify: Confirm the bind is held while the extension approval is outstanding.
Pass when no extended terms are applied ahead of the approval decision.

steps.title: Record the approved terms and warranty date on the billing account
sop: Apply the approved payment method, schedule and warranty date to the billing account.
Attach the approval reference to the account where terms were extended.
Done when the account reflects the approved terms with the approval attached.
verify: Re-open the account and confirm the warranty date and approval reference are stored.
Pass when every extended term on the account carries an approval reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: The gross line on this risk and the treaty and facultative capacity supporting it
generic.In-scope period: Policy inception date through expiry, matched to the treaty programme year
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross line, treaty section, facultative share and reinsurer security rating recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Facultative shares signed by reinsurers equal the facultative portion required
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed facultative slip attached to the submission with the signing date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unplaced capacity logged with the decision to reduce the line or hold the bind
generic.Test population: All large or complex risks bound in the period requiring reinsurance support
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero net retained lines above treaty retention without facultative confirmation on file
generic.Exception handling path: Shortfall in capacity referred to the Reinsurance Underwriter before the bind is authorised
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed reinsurance or facultative confirmation attached before the bind date
generic.Evidence location: Reinsurance administration system placement record and the submission in the workstation

steps.title: Compare the gross line to treaty capacity in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Read the gross line and limit from the quote in the underwriting workstation.
Apply the treaty capacity for the section in the reinsurance administration system.
Done when the portion needing facultative support is calculated.
verify: Recalculate the facultative portion as gross line less treaty capacity.
Pass when the calculated facultative requirement matches the placement being sought.

steps.title: Confirm each reinsurer has signed its facultative share on the slip
sop: Open the facultative placement slip held against the risk.
Confirm each reinsurer has signed for its written share.
Done when every share on the slip carries a reinsurer signature.
verify: Total the signed shares and compare to the facultative requirement.
Pass when the signed shares fully cover the facultative requirement.

steps.title: Check each reinsurer against the approved security list
sop: Look up each participating reinsurer on the approved security list.
Confirm the current financial strength rating meets the minimum standard.
Done when every participating reinsurer is confirmed approved.
verify: Re-check ratings as at the bind date rather than at slip issue.
Pass when no unapproved or sub-standard reinsurer holds a share.

steps.title: Confirm the treaty programme is in force for the inception date
sop: Open the treaty record and read the programme period and covered lines.
Confirm the policy inception falls inside the treaty period and the line is covered.
Done when treaty coverage for the risk is confirmed.
verify: Compare the policy inception date to the treaty period start and end dates.
Pass when inception falls inside an in-force treaty covering the line.

steps.title: Refer any capacity shortfall to the Reinsurance Underwriter
sop: Identify any portion of the line still unplaced after treaty and facultative support.
Refer the shortfall with a recommendation to reduce the line or hold the bind.
Done when the shortfall referral is raised and a decision is recorded.
verify: Confirm the bind remains held while the shortfall referral is open.
Pass when no risk binds with an unplaced and unreferred capacity shortfall.

steps.title: Attach the signed reinsurance confirmation to the submission
sop: Upload the signed slip or reinsurer confirmation against the submission.
Record the placement reference from the reinsurance administration system.
Done when the confirmation is attached and the bind step is released.
verify: Open the attachment and confirm signatures and shares are legible.
Pass when a signed confirmation dated before bind is on the submission.
